name: Nine Repositories Worth a Look
script:
Nine repositories worth a closer look. One clear point each.

ECC packages skills, agents, and hooks. Start small.

CLI-Anything turns desktop software into command-line tools for agents.

Screenshot-to-code turns reference images into web layouts. A first pass.

ScrapeGraphAI extracts web data from prompts, not brittle selectors.

Google Skills adds agent skills for cloud and developer workflows.

DeepSeek Harness is a plugin-based agent framework. A developer preview.

Humanizer rewrites prose that sounds AI-generated, but leaves code alone.

Stop Slop adds writing rules and a rubric for reviewing prose.

OmniRoute routes requests across model providers behind a single endpoint.

The pattern? More tools are now packaged for agents to use.

Pick what fits your workflow, and read the README first.

Subscribe for more content.
reference: Jerry PM — 9 Cool Repositories I Found on the Internet This Week (Stackademic, 6 September 2026; author-supplied PDF)
reference_notes: Built from the author-supplied PDF of '9 Cool Repositories I Found on the Internet This Week' (Stackademic, 6 September 2026), pages 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12 and 13. Visuals are original typography cards plus crops of the article's own section headings and repository slugs; they are excerpts, not live demos. English narration was generated locally with Kokoro am_michael at 0.96 speed and levelled locally with FFmpeg. Twemoji/Gemini Nano were not used. Star counts, token-saving percentages and provider counts from the article are deliberately omitted because they change. Narration loudness normalised locally with FFmpeg (measured -27.12 LUFS / -5.25 dBTP, gain 3.75 dB, target -16.0 LUFS and -1.5 dBTP). Narration levelled locally with FFmpeg loudnorm (source -27.12 LUFS / -5.25 dBTP, per-take target -16.0 LUFS and -1.5 dBTP, shared trim 1.1 dB).

upload.title: 9 GitHub Repos Worth a Look | AI Tools for Developers
upload.description:
Nine repositories from this roundup, one clear point each: agent skills and hooks, command-line tools for desktop apps, screenshot-to-code, prompt-driven scraping, an agent framework in developer preview, two prose editors and an AI gateway.

Repositories in the order I saved them:
1. ECC — https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC
2. CLI-Anything — https://github.com/HKUDS/CLI-Anything
3. screenshot-to-code — https://github.com/abi/screenshot-to-code
4. ScrapeGraphAI — https://github.com/ScrapeGraphAI/Scrapegraph-ai
5. Google Skills — https://github.com/google/skills
6. DeepSeek Harness — https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
7. Humanizer — https://github.com/blader/humanizer
8. Stop Slop — https://github.com/hardikpandya/stop-slop
9. OmniRoute — https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute

Source article: https://blog.stackademic.com/9-cool-repositories-i-found-on-the-internet-this-week-4966841b1a22

Narration is local synthetic speech (Kokoro). Visuals are article imagery and original typography, not live demonstrations of any repository.
